title: assets.manifest.json (game repo)
description: Every external asset the game uses: where it came from, its licence, and where its files are in the repo. Store packs may sit in any folder; what matters is that every path listed under files is committed in the repo (store content is never git-ignored; the repo stays private). The validator checks each path against the tracked files. One format for every game (user rule): a file in any other shape is an error; tools/migrate-assets-manifest.py converts the earlier shapes.

origin.description: studio = made in-house by the studio (e.g. its own earlier project), needs a description instead of a url; third-party (the default when absent) = from a store or another author, needs an https url

description.description: required for origin studio: what it is and where it came from inside the studio

source.description: where it came from: Fab, Poly Haven, ambientCG, Kenney, Google Fonts, ...

url.description: the listing or source page; required unless origin is studio

licence.description: e.g. Fab Standard License, CC0 1.0, SIL OFL 1.1

store.description: true for paid or store-licensed content (Fab and other marketplaces)

files.description: repo-relative paths of the files used; a path ending in / stands for every file under that folder. Each must be committed.

changes.description: what was changed (materials, kitbash, trimmed, re-imported, ...), or none
